_comment: Packages whose licence ships as a LICENSE file inside the package (nuget-license reports type File, which it cannot map). Verified by reading the file; keep the version pinned so a licence change on a bump is re-checked.

The native SQL Server network library that Microsoft.Data.SqlClient loads on Windows. Its LICENSE.txt is the MICROSOFT SOFTWARE LICENSE TERMS for the MICROSOFT.DATA.SQLCLIENT.SNI LIBRARY: proprietary, and section 3 makes the whole package Distributable Code that may be copied and distributed inside an application. Mapped to an identifier of its own, which allowed-licenses.json lists.

The native sign-in broker (msalruntime) that Microsoft.Data.SqlClient brings in through Microsoft.Identity.Client.Broker. Its LICENSE is a generic MICROSOFT SOFTWARE LICENSE TERMS: proprietary, and clause 3(e) says the licensee will not share, publish or distribute the software. Accepted by the repository owner as an explicit exception; mapped to an identifier of its own, which allowed-licenses.json lists.
